name: Joint Builder
description: Hinges, springs and pistons, and the rule that a contraption is just joints that agree. The builder is the authoring verb of the genre: a player selects two parts, picks a joint kind, and the machine gains a degree of freedom. Every joint kind is the same contract with different limits, which is why they are one component rather than four — a hinge is a spring with infinite stiffness on five axes. Joints break under declared load, because a contraption that cannot fail is a contraption with no engineering in it, and the break is announced so the debris can be simulated rather than deleted.

inputs.name: breakForce
inputs.description: Load a joint carries before it fails. 0 makes joints unbreakable, which removes the engineering.

inputs.name: motorMaxTorque
inputs.description: Torque a powered hinge or piston can apply.

outputs.name: brokenThisSession
outputs.description: Joints that have failed under load.
